correctness.rationale: Each word in a partial bijection and its inverse is a translation by its signed exponent on each chain, allowing rank comparisons that prove generator rigidity. The cyclic-only case is a cyclic group on a fixed support with Euler-totient generator multiplicity. Exact component EGFs and divisor Möbius inversion give the full two-parameter counts. The asymptotic inequality follows from explicit rook-monoid and partial-permutation counts. Brute inverse-submonoid closure and independently computed rational coefficient values agree for all degrees zero through five.

value.rationale: The exact multiplicity of embedded monogenic inverse submonoids (rather than their abstract isomorphism types) is a natural missing incidence count. The two-parameter chain/cycle-period spectrum and distinct generator fibers yield concrete integer formulas for all labeled degrees; the one-half density is a structural limiting invariant. This differentiates different embeddings with identical abstract type and answers more than a single small-value enumeration.
